nodes.label: Dev Log: Repo Cleanup Policy Foundation (2026-04-10)
ADR 0014: Public Docs Surface and Repo Hygiene Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Durable cleanup contract: first-class root docs allowlist, authority chain (PLAN_OF_RECORD -> ARCHITECTURE -> STRATEGY_PLAYBOOK -> roadmap v5.1 -> CURRENT_STATE), non-destructive first-pass boundary. README/INDEX have zero authority (navigation only); dev_logs and obsidian-vault are excluded subsystems.
